categories.title: Typography & Font Hierarchy
categories.summary: Rules for font scales, line heights, tracking, and contrast.

rules.rule: Headings sized text-4xl or larger must include tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Constrain body text paragraphs to max-w-xl or max-w-2xl for optimal reading length (60-75 chars).
Secondary text on dark surfaces must not go darker than text-neutral-400 to maintain WCAG AA readability.

categories.title: Color Systems & Surfaces
categories.summary: 60-30-10 palette balance and avoiding AI gradient slop.

rules.rule: Avoid generic purple-to-pink gradient buttons. Use clean neutral surfaces with subtle lighting borders or single-color accent highlights.
In dark mode, prioritize thin borders (border border-neutral-800) over heavy blurred shadows.

categories.title: Layout, Spacing & Bento Grids
categories.summary: Consistent 8-point spatial rhythm, responsive containers, and asymmetrical bento cards.

rules.rule: Multi-column grids must start with grid-cols-1 on mobile and use responsive prefixes (md:grid-cols-2, lg:grid-cols-3).
Always wrap landing and dashboard content within mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8.
Do not hardcode arbitrary pixel dimensions like w-[487px]. Use fractional widths, responsive scale or w-full max-w-md.

categories.title: Accessibility & Interaction Polish
categories.summary: Focus rings, aria labels, and interactive transitions.

rules.rule: All interactive buttons and links must specify focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none.
Interactive cards and clickable elements must include hover transition and active:scale-[0.99] feedback.
